title: Call himself
subtitle: 「稱自己為……」，究竟是在怎樣稱呼／看待自己？
description: 「稱自己為……」，究竟是在怎樣稱呼／看待自己？

words.meaning: 形容自己是；把自己描述為
words.note: 表示一個人用某些詞語描述自己的身份、性格、背景或狀態。語氣中性，重點在「怎樣描述」。
words.example: He describes himself as a practical person who prefers simple solutions.
words.exampleZh: 他形容自己是一個務實、偏好簡單解決方法的人。

exercises.original: In the interview, he called himself a quiet person who prefers listening to speaking.
exercises.zh: 在訪問中，他形容自己是一個安靜、較喜歡聆聽而不是說話的人。
exercises.upgrade: described himself as · 形容自己是

options.explanation: 這裡只是中性地說明他如何描述自己的性格，describe himself as 最自然。
語氣太正式、太像公開宣告，不適合普通性格描述。
表示他實際不是安靜的人而故意假裝，原句沒有這個意思。
表示客觀地變成某種狀態，不是自我描述。
通常表示給自己取名字，不適合性格特質。
帶宣傳或自我推廣意味，不合普通訪問語境。

exercises.original: He calls himself politically independent and says he does not belong to any party.
exercises.zh: 他形容自己在政治上屬於獨立立場，並表示不屬於任何政黨。
exercises.upgrade: describes himself as · 把自己描述為

options.explanation: 可以在特定評論語境使用，但通常帶更強的自我定位或形象塑造意味。
中性地報告一個人如何描述自己的立場，最貼切。

words.note: 表示一個人在觀念上把自己歸入某種身份或角色。比 see himself as 稍正式。
words.example: He regards himself as a teacher first and a researcher second.
words.exampleZh: 他首先視自己為教師，其次才是研究人員。

exercises.original: Although he runs the laboratory, he calls himself a scientist rather than an administrator.
exercises.zh: 雖然他管理實驗室，但他視自己為科學家，而不是行政人員。
exercises.upgrade: regards himself as · 視自己為

options.explanation: 這裡談的是他如何理解自己的主要角色，regard himself as 很合適。
只表示在自我介紹時使用某個身份，不一定反映深層自我認知。
受詞變成實驗室，意思完全不同。
表示假裝，原句沒有這層意思。
表示身份客觀改變，而不是主觀視自己為。

exercises.original: He has always called himself a mentor to the younger members of the team.
exercises.zh: 他一直把自己視為團隊中年輕成員的導師。
exercises.upgrade: regarded himself as · 視自己為

options.explanation: 會更強調他對外塑造出的形象；這句主要談長期自我看法。
regard oneself as 表示穩定地把自己看作某種角色。
句型錯誤；award 表示頒授。
表示真正成為，不等於如何看待自己。

words.meaning: 認為自己是；把自己視為
words.note: 表示一個人經過判斷後認為自己具有某種身份、特質或地位。
words.example: He considers himself an experienced negotiator.
words.exampleZh: 他認為自己是一名有經驗的談判者。

exercises.original: He calls himself an expert in contract negotiation after twenty years in the field.
exercises.zh: 在這個領域工作二十年後，他認為自己是合約談判專家。
exercises.upgrade: considers himself · 認為自己是

options.explanation: consider oneself + noun/adjective 是自然句型，表示對自己的判斷。
在這個意思下通常不需要 as；標準教學中以 consider himself an expert 為自然形式。
只是自我介紹動作，不完整表達自我判斷。
句型錯誤；應說 pretends to be。

exercises.original: Despite his achievements, he does not call himself particularly talented.
exercises.zh: 儘管成就不少，他並不認為自己特別有天分。
exercises.upgrade: consider himself · 認為自己

options.explanation: 表示對外宣傳自己的形象，不適合純粹內在自我評價。
後面直接接形容詞 particularly talented，自然表示自我判斷。
缺少 to；應為 refer to himself as。
不自然，也不是這個意思。

words.note: 非常常見而自然，表示一個人的自我形象或自我認知。
words.example: He sees himself as someone who can bring different groups together.
words.exampleZh: 他視自己為一個能把不同群體凝聚起來的人。

exercises.original: He calls himself a bridge between the technical team and senior management.
exercises.zh: 他視自己為技術團隊與高層管理之間的橋樑。
exercises.upgrade: sees himself as · 視自己為

options.explanation: 這是非常自然的自我角色認知表達。
表示給自己獎項或榮譽，不合語境。
表示客觀變成，而不是如何理解自己。

exercises.original: He no longer calls himself a beginner after completing several major projects.
exercises.zh: 完成數個大型項目後，他不再把自己看作初學者。
exercises.upgrade: sees himself as · 把自己看作

options.explanation: 表示他的自我認知已經改變，非常自然。
描述的是項目，不是他自己。
意思不同，通常表示恢復正常狀態。

words.meaning: 把自己當作；認為自己是
words.note: 表示一個人在心中把自己理解為某種類型的人。語氣自然、帶主觀自我概念。
words.example: He thinks of himself as an artist rather than a businessman.
words.exampleZh: 他把自己看作藝術家，而不是商人。

exercises.original: He calls himself more of a craftsman than a designer.
exercises.zh: 他把自己看作更像工匠，而不是設計師。
exercises.upgrade: thinks of himself as · 把自己當作

options.explanation: 很自然地表達個人的自我概念和分類方式。
表示給自己某種獎項或榮譽。

exercises.original: Although others call him a celebrity, he calls himself an ordinary working actor.
exercises.zh: 雖然別人稱他為名人，但他把自己看作普通的職業演員。
exercises.upgrade: thinks of himself as · 把自己看作

options.explanation: 重點是他內心如何理解自己的身份，而不是別人給他的標籤。
錯誤暗示他其實不是演員。

words.note: 表示一個人把某種身份視為自己的一部分。常見於身份、文化、職業、群體或個人認同語境。
words.example: He identifies as a writer, although most of his income comes from teaching.
words.exampleZh: 他自我認同為作家，雖然大部分收入來自教學。

exercises.original: Although he works in education, he primarily calls himself a writer.
exercises.zh: 雖然他從事教育工作，但他主要自我認同為作家。
exercises.upgrade: identifies as · 自我認同為

options.explanation: 這裡談的是個人把哪一種身份視為自己的主要認同，identify as 很貼切。
表示自行授予獎項或榮譽。

exercises.original: On the form, he calls himself bilingual because he grew up using both languages.
exercises.zh: 在表格上，他自我認同為雙語使用者，因為他從小使用兩種語言。
exercises.upgrade: identifies as · 自我認同為

options.explanation: introduce himself as 通常涉及向別人作自我介紹，不是填表時的身份認同。
適合表格、人口資料或個人身份分類語境。
不是說他在當下變成雙語使用者。

words.meaning: 自稱；提到自己時稱自己為
words.note: 重點是他實際使用某個稱號、名稱或身份詞來稱呼自己。
words.example: In interviews, he often refers to himself as an independent researcher.
words.exampleZh: 在訪問中，他經常自稱為獨立研究員。

exercises.original: In his articles, he often calls himself a "citizen scientist."
exercises.zh: 在文章中，他經常自稱為「公民科學家」。
exercises.upgrade: refers to himself as · 自稱

options.explanation: 重點是他在文字中實際使用這個稱號來稱呼自己。
描述的是文章，不是自己。

exercises.original: During the podcast, he repeatedly called himself a former entrepreneur.
exercises.zh: 在播客中，他多次稱自己為前企業家。
exercises.upgrade: referred to himself as · 稱自己為

options.explanation: 重點是他在說話時反覆使用某個身份稱呼自己。

words.meaning: 把自己呈現為；對外塑造自己為
words.note: 表示一個人在別人面前刻意展現某種身份、形象或特質。
words.example: He presents himself as a calm and reliable leader.
words.exampleZh: 他把自己塑造成一個冷靜而可靠的領袖形象。

exercises.original: In meetings, he calls himself calm and solution-focused, even under pressure.
exercises.zh: 在會議中，即使有壓力，他也把自己呈現為冷靜而重視解決問題的人。
exercises.upgrade: presents himself as · 把自己呈現為

options.explanation: 這裡強調他在別人面前展現出的形象。
句型錯誤，且 present himself as 不必然含有虛假意味。

exercises.original: When speaking to clients, he calls himself a partner rather than a salesperson.
exercises.zh: 與客戶交談時，他把自己呈現為合作夥伴，而不是銷售員。
exercises.upgrade: presents himself as · 呈現為

options.explanation: 這裡重點是面對客戶時刻意採取的對外角色定位。
通常表示恢復正常狀態，意思不同。

words.note: 表示透過說話、寫作或公開形象，把自己描繪成某種類型的人。通常比 present himself as 更強調形象建構。
words.example: In his memoir, he portrays himself as an outsider who challenged the system.
words.exampleZh: 在回憶錄中，他把自己描繪成一個挑戰體制的局外人。

exercises.original: In his autobiography, he calls himself a reluctant leader forced into public life.
exercises.zh: 在自傳中，他把自己描繪成一名被迫走入公共生活、不情願的領袖。
exercises.upgrade: portrays himself as · 把自己描繪成

options.explanation: 自傳是一種敘事與形象建構，portray himself as 很適合。

exercises.original: On social media, he calls himself an ordinary customer fighting a large corporation.
exercises.zh: 在社交媒體上，他把自己描繪成一個對抗大企業的普通消費者。
exercises.upgrade: portrays himself as · 描繪成

options.explanation: 可表示內在自我看法，但本句特別強調他在社交媒體上向公眾塑造形象。
非常適合公開敘事、自我形象建構的語境。

words.note: 較正式，表示用某種概括性的特徵或分類來描述自己。
words.example: He characterizes himself as cautious rather than pessimistic.
words.exampleZh: 他把自己界定為謹慎，而不是悲觀。

exercises.original: He calls himself cautious rather than opposed to change.
exercises.zh: 他把自己界定為謹慎，而不是反對改變。
exercises.upgrade: characterizes himself as · 把自己界定為

options.explanation: 這是較正式、分析性地用某個特徵界定自己。

exercises.original: In the survey, he called himself moderately optimistic about the future.
exercises.zh: 在調查中，他把自己描述為對未來抱持中度樂觀態度。
exercises.upgrade: characterized himself as · 描述自己為

options.explanation: 帶自我宣傳語感，不適合普通問卷。
正式地用一項特徵描述自己，很適合調查或分析語境。

words.meaning: 自封為；自稱為；把自己塑造成
words.note: 表示一個人採用某個稱號、角色或形象來稱呼／塑造自己。常帶較正式、文學或略帶批判的語氣。
words.example: He styles himself as a defender of traditional craftsmanship.
words.exampleZh: 他自稱為傳統工藝的捍衛者。

exercises.original: He calls himself a guardian of the town's traditional values.
exercises.zh: 他自稱為這個城鎮傳統價值的守護者。
exercises.upgrade: styles himself as · 自稱／自封為

options.explanation: 這種帶稱號感、較宏大的自我定位很適合 style himself as。
表示以某人／某物的名字為自己命名。

exercises.original: The columnist calls himself an independent voice outside the political establishment.
exercises.zh: 這名專欄作家自稱為政治建制以外的獨立聲音。
exercises.upgrade: styles himself as · 自稱為

options.explanation: 帶有自我定位、稱號化的語感，很適合評論性文字。
不是描述他自我標榜的方式。

words.meaning: 把自己宣傳為；自我標榜為
words.note: 表示一個人為了吸引注意、建立品牌或推廣自己，公開宣傳自己是某種類型的人。
words.example: He bills himself as a specialist in helping small companies grow.
words.exampleZh: 他把自己宣傳為協助小型企業成長的專家。

exercises.original: On his website, he calls himself a leading expert in executive communication.
exercises.zh: 在自己的網站上，他把自己宣傳為高階主管溝通領域的頂尖專家。
exercises.upgrade: bills himself as · 把自己宣傳為

options.explanation: 網站上的專業自我推廣正是 bill oneself as 的典型語境。
偏向內在自我看法，沒有宣傳意味。
沒有指定介紹對象，而且不強調廣告式定位。

exercises.original: The performer calls himself "the fastest magician in the country" in promotional material.
exercises.zh: 這名表演者在宣傳材料中自稱「全國速度最快的魔術師」。
exercises.upgrade: bills himself as · 自我宣傳為

options.explanation: 可以描述內在自我形象，但 promotional material 明確提示宣傳語境。
最貼合表演與宣傳文案中的自我標榜。
表示依照某人名字命名。

words.meaning: 給自己貼上……標籤；把自己歸類為
words.note: 表示明確地用一個標籤或類別來定義自己。
words.example: He is reluctant to label himself as either conservative or progressive.
words.exampleZh: 他不願把自己標籤為保守派或進步派任何一方。

exercises.original: He refuses to call himself either an optimist or a pessimist.
exercises.zh: 他拒絕把自己標籤為樂觀主義者或悲觀主義者。
exercises.upgrade: label himself as · 把自己標籤為

options.explanation: 句子強調他不願被簡單分類，所以 label himself as 最準確。

exercises.original: He is uncomfortable calling himself a specialist because his work covers several fields.
exercises.zh: 由於他的工作橫跨多個領域，他不太願意把自己標籤為某一類專家。
exercises.upgrade: labeling himself as · 把自己標籤為

options.explanation: 他抗拒單一分類，正是 label oneself as 的典型用法。

words.note: 表示較正式、明確地宣布或宣稱自己具有某個身份、立場或狀態。
words.example: He publicly declared himself to be an independent candidate.
words.exampleZh: 他公開宣稱自己是獨立候選人。

exercises.original: At the press conference, he publicly called himself an independent candidate.
exercises.zh: 在記者會上，他公開宣稱自己是獨立候選人。
exercises.upgrade: declared himself to be · 公開宣稱自己是

options.explanation: publicly 和 press conference 都顯示這是一個正式、明確的公開聲明。
只表示內在自我概念，沒有公開宣布的意味。

exercises.original: After the vote, he called himself the legitimate leader of the organization.
exercises.zh: 投票後，他宣稱自己是該組織的合法領袖。
exercises.upgrade: declared himself to be · 宣稱自己是

options.explanation: 涉及明確、正式地宣稱某種身份或地位，declare himself to be 很貼切。

falseSynonyms.zh: name himself 通常與名字或正式名稱有關；call himself 可以是名字，也可以是身份或稱號。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON He named himself Leo after moving abroad. He calls himself a consultant.

falseSynonyms.zh: introduce himself as 是特定社交場合中的自我介紹行為；consider himself 是自我判斷。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON He introduced himself as the project manager. He considers himself a patient person.

falseSynonyms.zh: 現代一般英語通常說 believe himself to be ...，而不是直接 believe himself + noun；consider himself + noun/adjective 更自然。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON He considers himself an expert. He believes himself to be an expert.

falseSynonyms.word: represent himself as / present himself as
falseSynonyms.zh: represent himself as 常表示他聲稱自己具有某身份或資格，某些語境甚至暗示可能失實；present himself as 更中性地描述對外形象。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON He presented himself as confident and approachable. He represented himself as a licensed adviser.

falseSynonyms.zh: pretend to be 明確表示實際上不是，卻假裝是。call himself 本身沒有這個含意。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON He calls himself an artist. He pretended to be a police officer.

falseSynonyms.zh: 客觀身份改變和主觀自我認知是兩件事。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON He became a manager last year. He regards himself as a mentor to younger staff.

falseSynonyms.zh: describe 後面需要清楚指出描述的是誰或甚麼；若是「描述自己」，要用 himself。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON He described the job as demanding. He described himself as patient.

falseSynonyms.zh: identity 是「身份／認同」的名詞；identify as 才是「自我認同為」。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON His professional identity changed over time. He identifies as a writer.
